question.text: In an LLP-form AIF used in many foreign jurisdictions (and permitted in India), the Manager is typically referred to as the _______ and the investors are referred to as the _______.

explanation.text: The Logic: In the LLP form, the manager is referred to as the General Partner (GP) and the investors as Limited Partners (LPs). LPs are non-managing/passive partners providing capital, while the GP holds management responsibility. The Trap: Options A, B, D mix up terminology from the trust form (sponsor, settlor, trustee, unitholder) or are fabricated. Note: The workbook (pp. 123-124) describes the foreign LLP usage of GP/LP terminology, with the manager as GP and investors as LPs in a non-managing role.
